description: An autumn landscape dominated by a large gnarled tree with orange and ochre foliage in the center. Behind it are pale blue sky and faint grey-violet hills, with a strip of white ground and green grass at the bottom. The paint is applied in thick, energetic impasto strokes.
composition: central tree filling most of the frame, horizontal landscape format

description: A rural landscape of rolling brown and ochre hills with small reddish-brown village houses on a slope. Four blossoming trees with white and pink crowns stand in the foreground. The sky is rendered in broad horizontal bands of grey, white and blue-green.
composition: high horizon, diagonal hillside, trees scattered in lower half

description: A mountain landscape with a ruined stone fortress or tower complex in the middle ground. A pale river or stream winds through the foreground toward the viewer, flanked by green and yellow vegetation. Green mountains and a cloudy sky fill the background.
theme: historic fortress in a mountain valley
composition: fortress slightly left of center, river leading line from bottom left

description: A non-figurative abstract composition built from loose patches of ochre, orange, red, grey-blue and black. A vertical streak of red runs through the center, framed by darker grey and navy blocks on the edges. Brushwork is broad and layered.
lighting: no depicted light source; even gallery light
composition: central vertical red accent, dark blocks around the edges

description: An abstract composition with a pale cream and beige field in the upper left and right, and a dense cluster of dark blue, black, red and yellow strokes through the middle and lower left. Thick, scraped brushwork creates a turbulent, cloud-like effect.
composition: dark mass diagonally from upper center to lower left against light ground

description: An abstract painting with a grey-green border surrounding a central field of salmon pink, red and pale green strokes on the left and turquoise, blue and black on the right. Paint is applied in thick, gestural sweeps.
composition: warm left half versus cool dark right half inside a muted frame-like border

description: A square abstract painting of layered patches in red, purple, white, ochre and grey-blue. A bright cluster of white and red strokes sits in the center, surrounded by cooler grey and lavender areas. The surface shows thick, overlapping brushwork.
composition: central bright cluster, cooler tones at the edges

description: An abstract painting with a large mass of crimson, pink, ochre and white impasto strokes set against a dark grey background. The central mass has a rough, sculptural edge and resembles a heap or bouquet. Brushwork is heavy and textured.
lighting: no depicted light source; mass reads as lit against dark ground
composition: central warm mass occupying the lower two thirds against a dark field

description: A light blue painted field inside a rough white border, with a horizontal row of small colored dots in pink, green, orange, blue and red. Thin black and grey pencil-like lines and scribbles run around and through the dots. The work is behind glass with visible reflections.
medium_guess: mixed media on paper, under glass (guess)
lighting: flat, with glare reflections on glass
composition: horizontal band of dots across the center of a blue rectangle

description: A misty landscape with a single blue tree in the center, standing above a field of grey, rocky texture. The upper part is filled with soft white cloud and grey haze. A signature reading 'Vanni' appears in the lower left; the work is matted and framed behind glass.
medium_guess: acrylic or mixed media on paper (guess)
composition: single tree at center, horizon near middle, vertical format

description: An abstract work with vertical streaks and scraped layers of red, pink, ochre, gold and white over a pale blue ground. The surface looks scraped and dripped, revealing underlayers. Strong reflections of a window and room are visible on the glass.
lighting: flat, with strong glare reflections on glass
composition: vertical streaks across the full width, red concentration in lower right

description: A soft, pale blue scene of a fluffy white creature with a pointed hat sitting at a small café table holding a cup. A white awning with the faint word 'CAFE' slants across the top, and a chair stands beside the table. The whole picture is painted in misty blue-green tones.
composition: figure in lower left, diagonal awning top left, vertical format

description: An interior of a café or dining hall rendered in loose grey, white and brown strokes. Tables and chairs fill the middle ground, with a seated figure on the right and light falling through tall windows at the back. The scene is muted and almost monochrome.
lighting: backlight from windows, soft grey daylight
composition: deep interior perspective, tables across the middle, horizontal format

description: A caricatured café scene on an orange-brown background: a frowning man in a striped sweater holding dominoes, a woman in a hat and red top leaning on him, and a man smoking while reading a newspaper. A waiter in a tuxedo stands behind them, and a single bulb hangs from a lamp above the table with two cups.
lighting: single hanging lamp, flat warm background
composition: figures clustered across the lower half, lamp at top center

description: A cubist-style composition of tilted chairs and tables outlined in thick black lines on ochre, yellow and grey planes. A small black wine glass sits on one tabletop. The furniture is shown from multiple angles, as if tumbling across the canvas.
composition: diagonal, rotating arrangement filling the vertical frame

description: A collage-like composition of elegant figures in long coats, hats and gowns arranged across red, blue, grey and white color blocks. Handwritten text fragments, a red plant and a blue X shape appear among the figures. The work is framed behind glass with visible reflections.
theme: fashion and society of a past era
composition: row of standing figures across the width over geometric color blocks

description: Same artwork as F1-016, photographed again: elegant figures in coats, hats and gowns over red, blue, grey and white color blocks, with handwritten text fragments, a red plant and a blue X. Reflections on the glass are visible in the lower center.
theme: fashion and society of a past era
composition: row of standing figures across the width over geometric color blocks

description: A building facade abstracted into large vertical panels of dark green, white and blue, with scaffolding-like white grid lines. A partially legible sign reading '...CAFE' runs along the top. The paint is scraped and layered, giving a weathered texture.
composition: vertical panels across a horizontal format, sign along the top edge

description: A vertical cityscape of tall, dissolving buildings in blue-grey, ochre and rust tones. Arched windows, a domed structure, a balcony and a pointed spire emerge from vertical drips and scraped paint. The sky is a hazy blue-grey.
lighting: hazy, diffuse light with small bright accents
composition: dense vertical stacking of buildings, vertical format

description: A densely detailed fantasy scene on a black background, filled with floating figures, masks, flowers, swirling ornaments and patterned shapes. A white round object sits near the center and a jester-like figure appears in the lower right. Initials and '24' are written in the lower left; the work is in a gold frame behind glass.
lighting: no depicted light source; bright colors on black
composition: all-over swirling composition centered on a round white object

description: A seated woman with short black hair and a pale face, wearing a dark jacket with blue highlights, sits with one bare leg crossed over the other. She holds a tall glass with a yellow and red drink. The background is broken into loose patches of yellow, pink and blue.
theme: portrait of a woman at leisure
lighting: flat, bright color with no clear source
composition: figure fills the vertical frame, diagonal leg in lower left

description: A close-up of legs and feet under office desks: one person in grey pinstriped trousers and black heels, another with bare legs in tan loafers. Office chair wheels and dark desk legs appear behind them on a grey floor. The scene is cropped at knee height.
composition: low cropped viewpoint, feet in the lower half, horizontal format

description: Two stylized heads with dark hair and large round eyes peer upward at each other, lips pursed, emerging from a mass of red fluffy flowers. The upper background is plain white. The heads are drawn in loose black ink-like strokes.
composition: two heads facing each other at top, red flower field filling lower two thirds

description: A vineyard landscape with rows of dark vine stems on bright green rolling slopes in the foreground. A large flat-topped khaki and brown mountain rises behind, under a pale olive sky. A signature is visible in the lower right.
composition: green foreground slopes, mountain band across the middle, high horizon

description: A watercolor-like landscape with a pale blue and pink sky over a row of dark green and black shapes resembling trees or bushes. The forms are loose and blurred at the bottom edge. The photo is slightly out of focus.
composition: wide sky in upper two thirds, dark forms along the bottom

description: Two round angels with golden halos, red cheeks and small closed-eye smiles stand side by side, one in white and one in blue. Between them they hold a plate with red eggs and a cake with a candle. The background is turquoise with small green grass at the bottom.
composition: two figures centered side by side, plate between them

description: A small angel in a long blue robe with white wings and golden hair is painted on a dark bird feather, mounted on a white board. lighting: flat, with shadow of photographer on glass
composition: tall narrow feather centered vertically on white ground

description: An abstract painting of energetic yellow strokes slashing diagonally across black, grey, white, blue and red areas. The paint is thick and smeared, with a red and blue border showing at the edges. No recognizable forms.
composition: all-over diagonal strokes with darker center

description: A drip and splatter abstract with a large yellow-green triangular form in the center rising like a mountain. Around it are dense splatters of white, red, black, teal and purple paint. The surface is glossy and layered.
theme: mountain in an explosion of color
composition: central triangular shape surrounded by all-over splatter

description: A grey smoky field with soot-like dark patches and layered translucent paper shapes. Thin red curving lines loop across the surface like a maze. A small signature appears in the lower right.
medium_guess: mixed media, smoke or spray on paper (guess)
composition: all-over texture with looping lines across the vertical field

description: Two stylized female faces with long multicolored streaked hair, red cheeks and red lips lean toward each other on a grey-green background. description: A still life of a dark green bottle and a large olive-colored two-handled jug, with three red pomegranates in front on a crumpled white cloth. A pale green and pink drapery hangs behind. There are reflections on the glass.

description: A night street scene washed in violet, with tall buildings lit by small yellow windows converging toward a sign reading 'Cafe'. Small doll-like women in short dresses and boots stand along both sides of the street. The paint is applied in loose vertical strokes.
composition: one-point perspective toward the café sign, figures along both sides

description: An outdoor café in a park with elegantly dressed people in period costume seated at round tables with white and red tablecloths. Bottles and glasses stand on the tables, and in the background tall trees frame a white building with a 'CAFE' sign. The sky is grey and cloudy.
composition: tables in foreground and middle ground, building in distance under trees

description: Same artwork as F1-040, photographed again: a dark green bottle and an olive two-handled jug with three red pomegranates on a crumpled white cloth, against green and pink drapery. Reflections on the glass are visible.
composition: jug center, bottle left, fruit row along the lower middle

description: A geometric abstract of nested rectangular frames in pink, yellow-orange, dark blue, green and black. composition: concentric frames receding toward the lower left

description: Three blue-violet irises with yellow beards and green stems stand against a golden ochre background. Thick impasto gives the petals a sculpted texture. Initials 'A.T.' and '2016' are written in the lower right.

description: A woven or embroidered tapestry-like image of a bright interior with white curtains and a vase of pink and dark flowers in the lower left. Soft lilac, cream and grey tones dominate, and the stitched texture is visible. Reflections of ceiling lights appear on the glass.
composition: tall curtains across the frame, flowers low left

description: A tapestry-like landscape of a village with small white and pink houses among purple, orange and red flowering trees. Green and lilac hills rise behind under a blue and white sky. The stitched texture is visible, with light reflections on the glass.
composition: houses mid-height, blooming trees in the foreground, hills behind

description: A stylized female figure with a faceless pale oval head and flowing auburn hair, wearing a long rust-red dress that sweeps diagonally across the canvas. The background is cream and ochre with soft brown shadows. A signature 'B' with '2010' appears in the lower right.

description: A field of red, orange and yellow flowers under a blue sky, covered with dense splatters and drips of white, yellow and orange paint. Green stems fill the lower part. The work is behind glass with a window reflection.

description: A surreal figure with a pale white elongated body and ribbed spine, bald head and green lips, shown in profile against a dark green background. lighting: flat, figure stands out against dark ground
composition: figure vertical along the left-center, heart lower right, hammer upper left

description: A lively ballroom or festive scene with women in long red, pink and white gowns dancing beneath hanging garlands and streamers. The strokes are loose and expressive in yellow, pink, green and white. A signature appears in the lower left; the work is matted behind glass.

description: A calligraphic artwork in which black Arabic script forms the shape of a whirling dervish with a tall hat and flared skirt. Small red ornamented shapes mark the hat, a foot and a decorative medallion on the left. The ground is pale marbled cream, matted inside a dark frame.
composition: figure formed by script on a diagonal, filling the vertical frame

description: A monochrome cream and beige relief-like painting of three nude female figures: one seen from behind in the center with long hair, flanked by two seated women. Small sailboats appear on the sea in the background. Outlines are raised and textured.

theme: woman and flower, femininity and nature
composition: figure upper left, flowers framing a bright central opening

description: Same artwork as F1-056, photographed again: a pale ribbed surreal figure in profile with a hammer in its head and a red anatomical heart outside the body inside a white geometric outline, on a dark green background with black branches.
lighting: flat, figure stands out against dark ground
composition: figure vertical along the left-center, heart lower right, hammer upper left

description: A dark still life with a crystal wine glass, a dark vase holding a branch of tiny white flowers, and two golden-yellow fruits on a table. Small colorful flower dots and white sparkles are scattered over the dark background like confetti or stars. A signature is in the lower right.
composition: objects in the lower left on a diagonal table edge, flowers rising upward

description: A collage of reproductions of Renaissance-style angels with golden halos, set into a crumpled, textured surface painted in red, orange and green with gold highlights. medium_guess: collage with crumpled paper and paint (guess)

description: Four fish hang on strings against a crumpled white paper or cloth background, two golden-brown above and two grey-silver below. The surrounding background is dark and speckled. Fine white lines cross the composition.

description: A ballerina in a dramatic forward bend, with her dark hair in a bun and her legs extended in a bent pose. She is painted in white and grey against dark blue-grey vertical drips. A signature 'Bacho' appears in the lower right.
lighting: soft, figure highlighted against dark drips
composition: figure filling the vertical frame on a diagonal

description: A loose, washed cityscape with grey-blue building facades on the right and pink and brown horizontal bands suggesting rooftops and sky. Grey clouds sit in a pale sky. White columns and dripping strokes are visible, with a signature in the lower right.
medium_guess: watercolor or ink wash on paper (guess)

description: A townscape with a stone bridge with white railings and lamp posts on the left, a tall evergreen tree in the center, and an old two-story house with a wooden balcony on the right. Red-roofed buildings rise behind under a pale sky. The foreground riverbank is light and sandy.

description: A long horizontal drawing of a hilly landscape with scattered houses, small trees, a few pink blossoming trees and grazing animals. Blue mountains run along the top. It is drawn with charcoal and colored crayon on cream paper and signed in the lower right.

description: A simple pastel landscape with three green trees with black trunks on an ochre ground. Behind them are blue hills, and a single black bird flies in a pale grey sky. A signature is in the lower right.

description: A vase of flowers on a brown background: red poppies with black centers and white daisies with yellow centers above a dark, squat black vase. Green leaves are dabbed between the flowers. A signature is in the lower right.
composition: vase centered in the lower half, flowers fanning out above

description: A landscape with a pale ochre hill and a stone tower or fortress on top, with dark blue and pink shapes suggesting trees or buildings. Strong reflections of the photographer and the room on the glass obscure most of the lower half.
composition: hill across the upper half, tower at center

description: A street café scene with a tall cream and blue building, a red awning topped with orange flowers, and small figures walking and sitting at white tables below. A thin tree with green leaves stands on the left. The paint is thick and textured.

description: A massive dark purple-brown building with a tower and balustrade on the left and a columned portico on the right, under a pale mint sky with yellow patches. A chandelier hangs from a thin cord in mid-air in front of the building. Long light stripes fall across the dark foreground.
lighting: low, raking light with stripes on the ground
composition: building mass on the left, portico right, chandelier upper center

description: A grey and white field of vertical scraped strokes with a large dark print-like area in the center. Within the dark area, faint figures in historical costume appear, as if transferred from an old photograph or engraving. The image looks faded and partially erased.

medium_guess: image transfer and acrylic on canvas (guess)

description: An all-over pattern of green leaves outlined in lighter green, each with an orange streak, on a blue-green ground. Tiny pink, white and blue dots are scattered between the leaves. The composition has no focal point and fills the whole surface.

description: Pale pink four-petaled blossoms with yellow centers drift across a deep blue-violet background with pink and turquoise bands near the top. Thin white curved lines trail behind the flowers like wind. A signature beginning 'Gel...' appears on the right edge.
composition: flowers scattered evenly over the frame

description: A night scene of many small white birds with red breasts perched on thin white lines like wires or branches against a black textured sky. description: An all-over pattern of gold leaf-like shapes with fine orange veins, small dark dots and short turquoise brushstrokes on a reddish ground. The shapes swirl in many directions. Part of a gold frame is visible on the right.

description: A burgundy and pink field covered with rows of small rectangular house-like shapes with pale violet roofs and bare blue-violet trees. White dots fall across the scene like snow. The right side fades into lighter pink and white.

description: An all-over pattern of rounded pink and mauve cell-like shapes outlined in turquoise, with small dark dots and pink beads, on a dark maroon ground. The pattern lightens toward the right. It resembles cells, pebbles or petals.

composition: all-over repeating rounded forms

description: A green and yellow scene with a plant or fountain-like burst of turquoise and red spiky leaves rising from the bottom center. composition: radiating plant from the bottom center

description: A branching tree or plant with thin red-brown stems spreading diagonally from the lower right across a pale grey-blue ground. The background is filled with tiny squiggles and dots in green, blue and white, like blossoms or foliage. The texture is fine and densely worked.
composition: branches radiating from the lower right corner

description: An all-over pattern of small light-blue five-petaled flowers with yellow centers among dark brown round shapes, green leaves and purple patches. Thin gold swirling lines and small beads connect the elements. The whole surface is evenly filled.

description: An abstract of pinkish-violet hatched diagonal stripes forming zigzag bands, with wavy blue and red lines at the top. composition: horizontal bands at top, diagonal hatching below

description: An abstract composition of thick white, cream and ochre strokes in the center surrounded by deep teal, navy, mustard and maroon blocks. A small red accent appears right of center and a magenta patch in the upper right. The paint is layered and scraped.
composition: light central mass framed by dark edges

description: An abstract painting dominated by warm pink, rust and peach shapes resembling two rounded forms or figures, outlined by dark teal arcs. A glare of light reflects in the upper center. The background edges are muted brown.
lighting: glare on surface, no depicted source
composition: two rounded masses side by side, dark arcs between them

description: An abstract with a bright yellow area at the top left, a fiery red and orange mass on the left around a pale cream center, and a deep blue patch on the right. Pink and grey strokes fill the lower right. The brushwork is energetic and layered.
lighting: no depicted light source; glare on surface
composition: warm left half versus cool blue right

description: An abstract with violet, lavender and white strokes on the left, a mustard and rust area at the far left edge, and dark charcoal and teal masses on the right. Small red and orange accents are scattered through the middle. The surface is glossy with thick, scumbled paint.
lighting: no depicted light source; glare on surface
composition: light left side, dark right side

description: A vertical abstract of broad, layered strokes in dusty pink, ochre, rust, slate blue and charcoal. A dark blue-black vertical mass runs down the center, with lighter cream and peach patches on the left. The paint is thick and blended.

description: A vertical abstract with a fiery mass of red, orange and yellow strokes in the upper half over darker grey, mauve and blue layers below. A small bright blue accent sits near the center. The background is olive-khaki.

description: An abstract dominated by a dark charcoal-grey field broken by jagged shards of bright orange-yellow. Maroon and dark green appear at the edges. The strokes are angular and flat.

description: Two women in long white sleeveless dresses stand side by side holding long thin turquoise stems of large teal leaves. description: A dramatic legendary scene in a dark wooded landscape: a crowd of figures in historical dress gathers on the right around a kneeling man, while a half-naked man stands on the left near rocks. description: An abstract with large sweeping arcs of orange, red and green over a light turquoise ground. A curved dark blue and red line circles around the right side. Small splashes of yellow and blue are scattered across.

medium_guess: oil on canvas with attached wood (guess)
composition: shed upper left, tree right, cow and children in the foreground

description: A cityscape contrasting old and new: a crumbling red-brown building with arched windows and wooden balconies in the foreground, with laundry hanging from a balcony. Behind it rise modern white high-rises, construction cranes and an unfinished concrete tower, with green hills under a cloudy sky.
composition: old building in the lower half, new city stacked behind, vertical format

description: A large elephant with long curved tusks walks to the right, built from a cubist mosaic of triangular and square facets in blue, grey, ochre and orange. A large golden circle like a sun sits behind it. Striped zebra-like patterns appear inside the elephant's body.
lighting: warm glow from the golden circle
composition: elephant in profile filling the horizontal frame

description: Three elongated female figures with flowing red hair and long dresses float through a streaky multicolored sky, two of them blowing long trumpets. Small stars and a crescent moon are scattered around, and a tiny row of houses sits at the bottom. The paint is applied in horizontal, shimmering strokes.
theme: music and celebration in a dream sky
composition: figures across the upper half on a diagonal, village at bottom center

description: A thickly textured painting of two intertwined figures: a pale nude figure seated on the left embraces a second figure in yellow and white on the right. A small hat and a cane are visible. The background is turquoise, violet and rust with crusty paint.
lighting: warm, figures lit against dark ground
composition: figures interlocked across the center

description: A nude female torso seen from behind and in profile, with long dark hair, painted in warm ochre, rust and gold tones. The background is dark blue with flashes of green and red. The paint is thick and scraped.
lighting: warm light on the body, dark surroundings
composition: torso filling the vertical frame, head top left

description: A view of a white hillside town with blue-domed churches and stacked cubic houses overlooking the sea. Palm trees and small bell towers are visible, and clouds fill the sky. The image is highly realistic, close to a photographic print.
composition: town descending diagonally, domes in the lower right foreground

description: Three children with large heads, half-closed sleepy eyes and colorful wild hair stand in a row wearing blue, red and teal clothes. Two hold white paper boats and the middle one holds an egg-like object on a cranked machine. The background is bright yellow.
composition: three figures in a row filling the frame

description: A dense tropical waterside settlement of stilt houses with corrugated roofs in red, pink, yellow and blue. Palm and banana leaves grow between the houses and laundry hangs from balconies. Blue water fills the bottom with reflections of boats.
composition: houses stacked vertically, water along the bottom

description: A tall thin standing figure wrapped in a red cloak, with a dark head, large round earrings and a long staff, stands on a white background. Splatters and drips of red and yellow ochre paint cover the background. A signature is at the bottom.
composition: single tall figure centered vertically

description: A crowded village or market scene with many houses with corrugated roofs on a hillside. A huge crowd of small figures in bright clothing fills the lower half on a bright green ground. Electric wires run between the houses.
medium_guess: oil or acrylic on canvas, palette knife (guess)
composition: houses in the upper half, crowd across the lower half

description: Five tall women with dark faces and large beaded collars and earrings stand together in red, blue and black wraps. One carries a bundle of sticks on her head and another a gourd. Long staffs rise behind them on a white background, with dry grass at their feet.
composition: group of figures in a row filling the vertical frame

description: Three slender dancing women with raised arms and grass skirts, rendered in green and dark brown, move across a textured gold and green background. Circles, spheres and straight lines like a cosmic diagram overlap the scene. The surface has sand-like relief texture.
medium_guess: mixed media with sand texture on canvas (guess)
composition: three figures in a row across the center

description: An abstract of thick palette-knife strokes in yellow, white, dark blue, green and red. The marks resemble a crowd of figures or fluttering flags. The paint is heavy and layered.
composition: all-over vertical strokes

description: A rural Southeast Asian scene with thatched houses on stilts, laundry hanging on a line, and tall trees and mountains under a grey sky. A woman carries two baskets on a shoulder pole across a pale dirt road. 'NOY 2015' and 'Vientiane, Laos' are written in the lower left.
composition: houses in the middle, figure in the foreground center

description: A narrow old-town street leading to a baroque gate with an arch, with a church tower and ornate cream buildings on the left and trees in the middle. Small figures walk along the cobbled street. The paint is thick and textured.
composition: street perspective toward the gate, buildings on the left

description: A woman in a red jacket, blue jeans and a dark hat walks away from the viewer under a white umbrella, carrying a black bag. The rainy street around her is rendered in thick grey, white and brown palette-knife strokes.
composition: single figure centered, seen from behind

description: A crowd of stylized women with black silhouetted faces and arms, wearing white dresses and white wide hats or head wraps, gathers at a market. Woven baskets with white grain and round fruit-like shapes fill the foreground. The whole scene is painted in cream, white and black.
composition: dense group of figures filling the frame

description: A companion scene of stylized women with black faces and arms in white dresses and hats at a market, one wearing a wide brimmed hat and another holding up a bunch of round fruits. Baskets and round white shapes fill the space. The palette is cream, white and black.
composition: dense group of figures filling the frame

description: A black-and-white African village scene with thatched round huts on both sides of a path leading to the shore. Two palm trees rise in the center and a boat with a sail and two people floats on the water. Birds fly in the sky and a few figures stand by the huts; a signature is in the lower left.
lighting: bright light reflecting on the water
composition: symmetrical huts on both sides, path leading to the boat in the center

description: Groups of tall stylized African women in red, blue and green wraps carry baskets and bundles on their heads beneath two flat-topped acacia trees. Two rounded huts stand in the lower center, with seated women and baskets beside them. The background is plain white.
theme: daily life in an African village
composition: figures in groups spread across the white field, trees at the top

description: A wide lake scene with stilt houses with thatched roofs on small islands on the left and right, surrounded by dark blue and brown trees. Small figures stand on the walkways and several people paddle narrow boats across the calm pale water. Temple towers and palms appear on the far shore, with birds in the white sky.
composition: symmetrical island clusters left and right, open water in the center

description: A row of five women in white head wraps and white dresses sit behind a market stall, painted in gold, grey and white with loose black outlines. In front of them are woven baskets of red fruit, a table with sliced watermelon, and large golden clay pots. The background is smeared grey.
composition: row of figures across the top, goods across the bottom

description: A realistic portrait of a middle-aged man with short greying hair and a slight smile, wearing a dark blue shirt. He holds a microphone and a sheet of paper in one hand and touches his chin with the other. The background is a soft blurred mix of dark red, green and brown.
lighting: soft frontal light on the face
composition: half-figure filling the vertical frame, face upper left

description: A sunset landscape painted with thick palette-knife strokes: a bright orange and yellow sky with a white sun, above a band of blue and purple hills. The foreground is a field of red, green and turquoise. Paint is applied in heavy, energetic impasto.
composition: horizontal bands: sky top, hills middle, field bottom

description: A man with dark swept-back hair in a dark jacket sits at a large pale green desk or console, looking down at papers. Faint figures are visible in the dark purple and green background, and a soft spotlight glows at the top right. The atmosphere is dim and theatrical.
theme: portrait of a man at work
composition: figure upper left, desk diagonally in the lower right

description: A collage of crumpled patterned fabric or paper in rust red and green with white fern prints, with a central strip of images: a woman at a table with a glass, red old-town houses with wooden balconies, and two figures in naive style wearing large hats. The central strip resembles naive Georgian painting.
theme: homage to naive painting and old town
medium_guess: collage on crumpled paper or fabric (guess)
composition: horizontal central band of images framed by patterned borders

description: A loosely painted landscape at sunset with a blue sky fading to orange and pink, purple swirling clouds and a dark blue tree clump on the left. A bridge crosses the distance and a red and white sign post stands on the right. The foreground is white and pale with dabs of blue and orange, like snow or water.
composition: high sky in the upper two thirds, landscape band below

description: An abstract of soft swirling cream, pale green and mauve shapes with a large dark burgundy and black mass across the middle. Curved and toothed silhouettes cut through the composition, and small detailed patches of color appear inside the dark mass. The surface is smooth and blended.
composition: dark horizontal mass in the center surrounded by pale swirls

description: An abstract with broad blocks of peach, ochre, rust, brown and slate blue paint outlined by dark lines. The strokes are thick and layered, suggesting overlapping planes. A bright orange accent appears in the lower right.
composition: overlapping blocks across the horizontal frame

description: A symmetrical mask-like face drawn in oil pastel with large oval eyes in rings of green, blue, pink and white, a long brown nose and an orange layered mouth. Purple, blue and orange shapes form the cheeks and ears. A border of short green and purple strokes surrounds the face; glare is visible on the glass.
composition: symmetrical frontal face filling the frame

description: A symmetrical abstract face built from bold bands: a red central nose shape flanked by blue and purple stripes, brown and pink eyebrow shapes, and a small red mouth near the bottom. Pale yellow, grey and light blue areas fill the background. Reflections of windows show on the glass.
composition: vertical symmetry around the central red shape

description: An abstract of thick, swirling strokes in red, coral, ochre, teal and white, with a dark curving black line through the lower middle. A white band runs along the bottom and a pale green patch in the upper right. The paint is applied loosely and wet-into-wet.
composition: warm central mass with cooler right side

description: An abstract with two glowing yellow areas on the left and center, surrounded by dark maroon, grey and black strokes, with a bright blue stripe running down the middle. Ochre and orange appear at the right edge. The surface is glossy with a strong reflection at the bottom.
lighting: no depicted light source; glare on surface
composition: two yellow focal points with dark surroundings

description: An abstract with large patches of coral red, orange and ochre in the upper half and right, a vertical sweep of blue and purple in the center, and a dark grey block in the upper right. The left and lower edges are pale cream. The paint is thick and gestural.
composition: warm masses around a cool central sweep

description: A vertical work covered with dense, streaky dark brown marks on a pale grey-white ground, resembling fur, hair or bark. The marks are brushed or scraped mainly vertically with ragged edges. Narrow white margins remain on both sides.
composition: dense vertical mass filling the center

description: A vertical work of dense, dry-brushed dark brown streaks on a pale ground, forming a hairy, textured mass with a curving shape in the upper left. White gaps break through the texture. It closely resembles a companion piece.
composition: dense vertical mass with a curving left edge

description: A seated woman in a cubist style wearing a hat topped with a blue fish and a lemon slice. Her face is shown in profile and front view at once, with dark hair, a blue blouse with a red and yellow collar, and hands folded on her lap. She sits in a dark chair against a pale background.
theme: portrait of a woman in a fish hat
composition: seated figure centered, filling the vertical frame

description: A bold portrait of a bearded man with large dark eyes, a curling moustache and red lips, wearing a yellow and blue plumed hat and a red and white ruffled collar. The face is grey with heavy black brushstrokes. A date '5.6.4.69' and a signature are written at the top right.
composition: head and shoulders filling the frame

description: A portrait of a bearded man with a plumed purple hat, red hair or collar and one large eye, his face split into light and dark halves. His blue doublet has fern-like patterns with orange circles. The background is beige cardboard-like with a white patch on the right; a number and signature appear at the top and bottom.
composition: frontal half-figure filling the vertical frame

description: A white unicorn with a long flowing mane and a small flower on its horn stands on clouds. Thin leafy branches grow out of its back. The background is a sky-blue field sprinkled with gold specks and soft clouds; reflections on the glass are visible.
theme: mythical unicorn in a dream sky
composition: unicorn in profile in the center of the horizontal frame

description: An arched stained-glass-window-like composition in deep blue, with a large purple and black sphere containing a yellow sun near the bottom. Fantastical animals, birds and a green horse-like creature float above, with a pink circle bearing Hebrew letters on the right. A line of Hebrew text runs along the bottom.
composition: arched format, sphere at the bottom, figures floating above

description: An arched stained-glass-window-like composition in deep red, with two hands holding a crown at the top. Below are a roaring lion-like animal in red and blue and faint city walls. Hebrew text runs across the lower right.
composition: arched format, crown at top, lion in the lower half

description: A surreal flat composition with a grey airbrushed donkey standing on a pale green woven floor, its long braided tail curling up the left side. A dark bird flies at the top dropping pink blossoms, and grey stepped tower shapes and a colorful scale-patterned square stand behind. The background is white with a reflected window on the glass.
composition: donkey lower right, braid sweeping from left, bird top left

description: A wall-like grey surface covered with layered, chalky handwritten Georgian letters in white, cream, pink, blue and black. The letters overlap densely like graffiti or a scratched blackboard. Vertical drips run through the text.
composition: all-over writing across the horizontal frame

description: A large organic ochre shape with a dark brown cap rises from a cluster of brown-outlined cream blobs at the bottom, with a mint-green patch among them. The background is pale blue with faint outlined rectangles. The forms are soft and fluid, like melting objects.
composition: vertical ochre form rising from a cluster at the bottom

description: Soft sausage-like shapes in grey, ochre and brown curve around the edges of a pale canvas, forming a loose ring. Two pink rectangles float in the center, connected by faint yellow lines. The paint is smooth and blended.
composition: ring of forms around the edge, two rectangles in the center

description: A green mountain landscape with a rushing white river, overgrown with large raised grass-like strokes in the foreground. On the left a group of people sits at a table with a patterned tablecloth. White fabric-like relief shapes hang from the top edge.
composition: figures on the left, grass covering the center, river to the right

description: A drawn composition with an arched opening through which a woman's legs in a pink high-heeled shoe and white dress are visible. Dark trailing hair or branches hang on the right, and colored lines in blue, orange and green fall vertically like threads or rain. Water with pale blue leaf shapes runs along the bottom.
medium_guess: colored pencil and pastel on paper (guess)
composition: arch in the center framing the figure, vertical lines throughout

description: An interior seen from above with a red carpet running toward a dark doorway, blue floor and walls, and a white grid like a window on the right. Two small framed pictures with sketched figures lean on the walls, a black-and-white checkerboard sits at the left, and a dark grey figure sits in the lower left.
composition: strong diagonal of the carpet toward the doorway

description: Two green tables with small colored balls on them stand on a yellow and orange floor, seen from above at a steep angle. The walls are teal and violet. The paint is thick and loosely applied.
composition: two tables on a diagonal in the lower half

description: A ping-pong table seen from above sits on a pink-purple triangular floor in front of a large red wall. Small figures play at each end, and a few small nude figures stand in the lower left. A black and white checkered strip runs along the bottom.
composition: central triangular floor with the table in the middle

description: An arched composition of a man with a moustache and cap playing an accordion beside a woman in a purple dotted dress holding a red flower. Behind them are a stone gateway, old houses with balconies, a church with a dome and a café sign reading 'ART CAFE', against a gold-leaf sky. A signature and '2021' appear at the bottom.
composition: two figures in the lower center, city rising behind in an arch

description: A blue and teal painted surface with a large dark rooster in the lower right. In the upper left a small flying machine carries tiny figures, next to a pinwheel. Handwritten formulas and numbers in yellow and red, such as 'E=mc²' variations and '2+2=?', are scattered across.
composition: rooster lower right, machine upper left, formulas scattered

description: An Egyptian-style papyrus painting of a falcon-headed god with a staff holding hands with a queen in a tall feathered crown and pleated robe. Hieroglyphs and cartouches fill the top. The figures stand on a dark base line against beige papyrus.
composition: two figures in profile side by side, text above

description: A papyrus chart titled 'THE HIEROGLYPHIC TRANSLITERATION' showing Egyptian hieroglyphs in a grid, each with its Latin letter equivalent. A row of number symbols from 1 to 1,000,000 runs along the bottom. It is drawn in black and gold on beige papyrus.
composition: grid of symbols filling the vertical frame

description: An Egyptian-style papyrus scene of a seated goddess with a horned sun-disc crown on a throne receiving offerings of lotus flowers from a standing pharaoh in a blue crown. Hieroglyphs and cartouches run along the top. Colors are yellow, orange, black, red and teal on beige papyrus.
composition: two figures facing each other, text band at top

description: An Egyptian-style papyrus fragment shape showing a man in a boat hunting birds in the marshes with a throwing stick, accompanied by a woman behind him and a small figure at his feet. Many blue, red and brown birds fly up from papyrus reeds on the right. Fish swim in blue water below.
composition: central figure in a boat, birds on the right

description: A large Eye of Horus in black and gold is flanked by a vulture with spread wings on the left and a rearing cobra on the right. A border of red and gold rectangles runs along the bottom. It is painted on beige papyrus.
composition: eye centered horizontally between two animal symbols

description: An Egyptian-style papyrus scene of a pharaoh drawing a bow while a lion runs at his feet, and a queen kneeling beside him handing him an arrow. Birds fly up from papyrus plants on the right, and cartouches appear at the top. Colors are gold, black and red on beige.
composition: pharaoh on the left, queen center, plants right

description: An Egyptian-style papyrus scene of a queen in a feathered crown anointing a seated pharaoh on an ornate red throne. A winged vulture hovers behind the pharaoh, and columns of hieroglyphs and cartouches frame the scene. Colors are gold, black and red on beige.
composition: two figures facing each other, hieroglyph column on the left

description: An Egyptian-style papyrus scene of a pharaoh in a war chariot drawing a bow, pulled by a rearing horse with an elaborate feathered headdress. A vulture with spread wings flies above, and columns of hieroglyphs fill the upper left. Colors are black, gold, red and cream on beige papyrus.
composition: horse on the left, chariot and archer right of center, moving left

description: An Egyptian-style papyrus scene of four seated women with long black hair and cones on their heads, wearing pale blue robes, clapping and playing a double flute. Two nude dancers bend and move on the right. Hieroglyphs run along the top.
composition: seated row on the left, dancers on the right

description: An Egyptian-style papyrus scene of four standing figures in profile: a goddess with a horned sun-disc crown, a pharaoh in a striped headdress, a falcon-headed god, and another pharaoh holding vessels. They hold hands and ankh symbols, with dense hieroglyphs and cartouches above. Mostly black and gold on beige.
composition: frieze of four figures across the width, text band above

description: An Egyptian-style papyrus image of a kneeling winged goddess in a red dress with huge outspread wings of white, black and gold feathers. She kneels on a stylized base, flanked by columns of hieroglyphs and small birds. The papyrus is beige with a gold border line.
composition: symmetrical figure centered with wings spanning the width

description: An Egyptian-style papyrus scene of a seated god in a white crown on a red and black throne, protected by a winged goddess behind him. A woman on the left presents an offering table, and an Eye of Horus appears on the right. Hieroglyphs fill the top in black, red and gold.
composition: seated god center, figures on both sides

description: An Egyptian-style papyrus scene of a kneeling winged goddess on the left facing a goddess with a horned sun-disc crown seated on a patterned throne on the right. Columns of hieroglyphs and cartouches fill the space between them. Colors are black, white, gold and ochre on beige.
composition: two figures facing each other, text columns between

description: A profile bust of an Egyptian queen with a tall flat-topped dark blue crown banded in red and gold, and a broad patterned collar. The figure is drawn with simple outlines on light papyrus. Strong reflections of a window and sky cover the glass.
lighting: flat, with strong reflections on glass
composition: profile bust centered, facing right

description: An Egyptian-style papyrus scene of three female musicians: one plays a lute, one a long-necked instrument and one a harp, with a nude dancer-musician in the middle. Offering stands with vessels and grapes appear at the top. Strong reflections of windows cover the glass.
lighting: flat, with strong reflections on glass
composition: three figures in a row in the lower half, offerings above

description: An Egyptian-style papyrus scene of two women walking hand in hand: a goddess with a horned sun-disc crown in a patterned purple and white dress holding a staff, and a queen in a tall feathered crown and pleated robe. Hieroglyphs and a cartouche are placed around them. Glare is visible on the glass.
composition: two standing figures side by side filling the vertical frame

description: An Egyptian-style papyrus profile bust of a queen wearing a vulture headdress and a broad red and gold collar, with long black hair. Hieroglyphs and a cartouche frame the head, and a band of lotus motifs runs along the bottom. Reflections of a window obscure part of the face.
composition: bust centered facing left, border at the bottom

description: A black-and-white painting of a small white tower on an islet in the water, with a city skyline of domes and minarets behind it. A rowing boat with two figures floats in the foreground, and birds fly in the cloudy sky. A ferry passes on the left.
composition: tower center, boat in the foreground, skyline across the middle

description: A harbor full of colorful wooden boats with tall pale masts and sails, moored among wooden posts in calm water. The sky is pastel pink and blue. Thick palette-knife strokes give a textured, glittering surface.
composition: boats across the middle band, open water in the foreground

description: A black-and-white painting of a white passenger ferry cutting through choppy water toward the viewer. Behind it is a city skyline with a domed mosque, minarets and a pointed stone tower. Gulls fly in the cloudy sky.
composition: ferry center, skyline across the middle, water in the lower half

description: A black-and-white rooftop view of a dense old city with a tall round stone tower with a conical roof rising in the center. Water and a skyline of domed mosques stretch behind under a pale cloudy sky with birds. Rooftops and building facades fill the foreground.
theme: old city tower above the rooftops
composition: tower center, rooftops in the lower half, skyline behind

description: A narrow vertical black-and-white painting of a waterfront mosque with a dome and a tall minaret, with a suspension bridge behind it. Pigeons gather on the paved square in front and a few people walk along the water. Paint drips run along the bottom edge.
composition: mosque in the middle, square with pigeons below, tall narrow format

description: A saint with a halo in a green and red robe rides a white horse, spearing a green dragon at the bottom with a long lance topped by a cross. A red cloak billows behind him. A young woman in yellow stands bound on a tree on the right, and script is written at the top.
composition: rider on a diagonal, dragon along the bottom, woman on the right

description: A Madonna in a blue striped mantle with a golden halo holds the Christ Child in a white robe. Two winged angels with swords stand above on either side. The background is bright yellow with concentric red and orange arches.
composition: central figure filling the frame, angels at the top corners

description: A close detail of a rider in a red cloak and dark robe holding a long lance, mounted on a white horse with a red bridle. An angel appears in the upper right, and script is written near the top. The colors are red, white and grey-green on a yellow ground.
composition: rider center, horse moving right

description: A haloed saint in a blue robe and red cloak rides a white horse with a red-tasseled harness, spearing a green dragon at the bottom. A woman's face peers out of a tree on the right, and Ge'ez script labels the figures. The background is yellow and violet.
composition: rider on a diagonal, dragon along the bottom

description: A Madonna in a dark speckled mantle with a halo holds the Christ Child in an orange robe on her lap. Two angels with swords stand behind her on either side, and script is written in red on the throne back. The palette is dark green, red, orange and yellow.
composition: central seated figures, angels at both upper sides

description: Five pink and peach roses with green leaves on a branch, painted against a soft green background. The flowers range from tight buds to fully open blooms. The canvas texture is visible.
composition: roses spread diagonally across the horizontal frame

description: A sunlit street leading to a monumental Central Asian building with blue tiled domes and a decorated portal, with a tall round minaret on the left. Two figures in long robes walk toward the archway. The walls are warm sandy beige under a hazy sky.
composition: street perspective toward the domed building, minaret left

description: A white house with small dark windows stands between two dark round trees under a deep blue night sky. The paint is extremely thick and crusty, built up in lumps. A signature and '2021' are in the lower left.
lighting: nocturnal, house glowing against dark surroundings
composition: house in the center framed by two trees

description: A densely packed hillside town of small houses with red, white and yellow walls, arched windows and red striped roofs, outlined in thick black lines. A winding yellow road cuts diagonally through the houses. The work is under glass with glare.
composition: all-over houses with a diagonal road

description: A bustling Central Asian street scene with figures in turbans and long robes walking and riding donkeys toward a large arched gateway. A blue-tiled dome rises behind yellow sunlit walls, and a man sits by the roadside on the left. A signature and '2016' appear in the lower left.
theme: busy street of an old Silk Road city
composition: street receding toward the gateway, dome upper left

description: A circular mandala-like design with two white decorated elephants raising their trunks toward each other in the center on a red floral field. Twelve small circles around it contain zodiac-like figures and animals, including a fish, bull, ram, scorpion, archer and dancers. Ornate gold and green floral scrolls fill the corners.
medium_guess: paint with gold on fabric or paper (guess)
composition: central circle surrounded by a ring of twelve medallions

description: A glittering sand-textured landscape of white and terracotta pagodas and temples among dark green trees at dusk. A pale moon or sun with a red ring glows in a pink-orange sky. A palm tree stands on the right.
composition: temples across the middle band, moon upper center

description: A sunlit park or garden with two tall tree trunks in orange-brown on the right and dense green foliage above. A low stone wall or bench sits in the lower left, with a dark shadow beneath. Bright yellow-green grass and hedges fill the middle.
composition: trees on the right, wall in the lower left

description: A tightly packed cubist-like composition of stylized African figures with mask-like faces, beaded necklaces and colorful striped garments. The shapes are outlined in thick black lines and filled with flat red, blue, purple, yellow and green. Hands, feathers and drums appear among the figures.
composition: all-over interlocking figures

description: An abstracted market or riverside scene in palette-knife strokes, with figures in white conical hats carrying baskets on shoulder poles. Reds, greens, blues and blacks are set against a bright yellow ground. A signature appears in the lower left.
composition: cluster of figures across the middle

description: An empty room seen in perspective with mustard-yellow walls and floor, and a window or painting opening onto a green landscape and blue sky at the back. Two dark figures embrace in the middle of the room, and two white dandelion-like circles sit on the floor. Yellow and dark paint is splattered across; a Georgian signature and '2019' appear at the lower right.
composition: one-point perspective room, figures center, window behind

description: Five tall women in long red dresses walk in a line toward the left, two carrying red patterned pots on their heads. Their thin black legs cross in rhythmic strides, and red heart shapes sit along the ground. A huge glowing yellow and white sun fills the background.
lighting: strong backlight from a setting sun
composition: row of figures across the frame against a central sun

description: A savanna landscape with a herd of dark cattle driven by Maasai herders in red under a large flat-topped acacia tree. A snow-capped mountain rises in the distance under a blue sky with white clouds. Other herders with spears stand on a rock on the right.
medium_guess: oil or acrylic on canvas, palette knife (guess)
composition: panoramic, herd across the middle, mountain at the top center

description: A long panoramic night or dusk scene over deep blue water with many small boats, some with covered cabins. Stilt houses with glittering roofs stand on both sides, and a bright reflection of light glows in the center of the water. Small birds fly in the dark sky.
theme: boats on the lake at night
composition: panoramic, houses at both ends, boats across the center

description: Seven slender women in orange, yellow, red and light-blue wraps walk away from the viewer, each balancing a large white pot on her head. Their reflections stretch below them on a blue, watery ground. The figures are drawn with quick black outlines.
composition: row of figures across the upper half, reflections below
